idea: Ring recursion: surround a central square of side 1−2a with a frame of 4(j−1) squares of side a=1/j along all four edges. Fill the central square recursively with the best scaled packing for the remaining count, and enumerate j and the recursion depth. One-sided L-frames already give n=6 (7/3) and n=11 (3/4 frame of 7 plus four squares of 3/8, totalling 3.25), and this generalises them to two- and four-sided frames.
